scope: Full BLAKE2b/BLAKE2s sequential-mode article only; no completion claim for SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE3, BLAKE2bp/BLAKE2sp, Argon2, the BLAKE2 paper's salt/personalization/tree modes, modes of operation, protocols, key management, implementations or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 RFC 7693 定义的 BLAKE2b 与 BLAKE2s 顺序模式：64/32 位字、12/10 轮、128/64 字节块、参数块、IV、SIGMA、G/F 压缩、计数器与最后块标志、密钥块、有密钥 MAC、摘要长度截取、OID、附录 A/B 逐轮向量与附录 E 自检；不把 SHA-2、SHA-3、BLAKE3、并行 BLAKE2bp/BLAKE2sp、Argon2、论文的 salt/personalization/树散列、工作模式或整个库并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers RFC 7693's BLAKE2b and BLAKE2s sequential mode: 64/32-bit words, 12/10 rounds, 128/64-byte blocks, the parameter block, IV, SIGMA, G/F compression, counter and last-block flag, key block, keyed MAC, digest truncation, OIDs, the Appendix A/B worked traces and the Appendix E self-test. It does not absorb SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE3, parallel BLAKE2bp/BLAKE2sp, Argon2, the paper's salt/personalization/tree modes, modes of operation or the whole library.

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. They are linked for context only and are not aliases, merged identities or completed by this article. BLAKE3 is a later independent design; SHA-2 and SHA-3 are comparison and contrast targets; Argon2 is a password-derivation construction that uses BLAKE2b as an underlying primitive but is not covered here.
